The crop shows 8 of the 9 icon slots filled with the saturated orange clip-art box, which is byte-for-byte the look of resources/package-icon.png; only Configuration.EnvironmentVariables shows a real (.NET) icon. The artboard crop draws every slot as a neutral grey tile with a monochrome package codicon. Geometry holds (DS-ROW-1 icon 36x36 x14, DS-RADIUS-2 icon 2px x14, both hard), so only the fallback's appearance differs. Which rows fall back is live content, but the fallback asset is the product's own, so §6's live-content exclusion does not cover it, and neither the spec nor any DS rule declares the difference.

refuted.finding: At rest, the Installed tab is boxed by a 1 px focusBorder ring (#0078d4 at x 6 to 144, y 77 to 111), drawn as the DS-FOCUS-1 tab ring. The artboard's installed-tab draws only the 1 px active underline at y 111, so the tab strip reads as keyboard-focused when the state has no focus.
refuted.reason: The crop does show a 1 px blue ring around the Installed tab, but this is the declared design, not a defect: the reach clicks the tab, main-installed-single is in FOCUSED_TAB_STATES, and DECISIONS.md rules that the main panel draws its focus ring on click too (2026-10-23, 'a ring after a click', UX-P2.5). The hard measurement reads 'DS-FOCUS-1@main-installed-single/tabs: tab [installed-tab]: outline 1 solid rgb(0, 120, 212) offset -1 (target … offset -1)'.

refuted.finding: The list pane ends 1 px short of the redline: the split divider is at x=326 and the details pane starts at x=327, against the spec's tab-bar and installed-list width 327 and package-details-panel x 328 (the artboard puts the divider at x=327). The scrollbar (318-325 against 319-326), the Uninstall Selected button (163-309 against 164-310) and the Direct Packages count badge all move 1 px left with it, while the 16 px end inset holds.
refuted.reason: The crop shows the scrollbar and the divider near x 318-327, but the claimed offset is 1 px, and the hard redline measurements put it within tolerance: 'SPEC@main-installed-single/list: 9/9 within 1' (tab-bar, installed-list, uninstall-selected-button), 'SPEC@…/details: 1/1 within 1' (package-details-panel), and MS-8 reads tab-bar 326.2 wide against the spec's 327.

refuted.finding: The Source Settings action in the header shows a gear glyph, but the approved artboard draws a different glyph in the same 22 px slot (ink extents are identical, 14 x 14). The capture's gear is the workbench's usual settings glyph, so either the artboard or the product should be brought in line.
refuted.reason: The capture draws the codicon settings-gear (docs/design/icons.json SettingsGearIcon), which the hard measurement confirms: DS-ICON-2 'glyph 16×16 ×3, colour icon.foreground ×3'. The artboard's glyph is a hand-drawn stroked SVG (a circle with 8 rays), not a codicon. The difference is the artboard's placeholder, not a defect in the capture.

refuted.finding: In the details pane the Authors row sits 1 px higher than the artboard (Version-to-Authors pitch 22 px against the artboard's 23 px), and everything below it (Required by, net8.0, netstandard2.0 and their dependency lines) sits 2 px higher than the artboard draws it (Required by ink top at y 194 against 196, the last line at 321 against 323).
refuted.reason: The Authors text sits at the same y in both images (value ink 155-164), so only the Verified mark moved, which is native-2's defect. The capture's block gaps are on the ramp and equal by role (hard DS-GRID-2a: 'gaps 4, 8'). The artboard's extra 2 px below Authors (Required by 196 against 194) comes from its taller Authors line box, an inline-flex value, not from a declared gap or rect in the spec.
